en.headline: Police investigate report of child carrying beer in Tuen Mun
en.dek: Officers said they received a report on Tuesday night at Fu Tai Estate. No arrest had been made, and the girl's school said it had offered help.
body: Police are investigating a report that a 10-year-old girl was made to carry bags of beer to a building at Fu Tai Estate in Tuen Mun on Tuesday night.

A police spokesman said officers received the report at about 10.30pm. The girl was in school uniform and was carrying two bags containing numerous beer cans, the South China Morning Post reported. Officers went to the scene. No arrest had been made and the investigation was continuing.

The girl's school, Lutheran Tsang Shing Siu Leun School, said social workers and teachers had stepped in after learning of the incident and had offered help and counselling to the pupil and her family.
Police have not named anyone in connection with the case. The child has not been named.

zh.headline: 警方調查屯門女童被安排搬運啤酒
zh.dek: 警方稱周二晚接獲富泰邨報案，暫未有人被捕。女童就讀的學校表示已提供協助及輔導。
body: 警方正在調查一宗報案，指一名10歲女童周二晚在屯門富泰邨被安排把啤酒搬到一座大廈。
警方發言人說，約晚上10時30分接獲報案。南華早報報道，女童身穿校服，手提兩袋共多罐啤酒。警員到場，暫未有人被捕，調查仍在進行。
女童就讀的香港路德會增城兆霖學校表示，得悉事件後社工及老師已經介入，並向學生及其家人提供協助和輔導。
警方未有公布涉事人士身份。女童姓名亦沒有公開。
